sn1.12:3.3: “Attachment” here is _upadhi_, which is both the things of the world to which we cling, and the inner clinging (see [snp1.2](), [sn12.66]()). The Jains defined _upadhi_ similarly (Tattvārthasūtra 9.26). The dominant meaning in Sanskrit is “fraud”, which perhaps informs the Buddhist sense: the things we attach to give a false sense of security.
